column3: requireActorActive (actor_active.go, #4159) reads only the acting user's own account row, not state of the secrets UpdateSecretFields writes, so it is an actor-authority check. A stale pass equals extend-then-suspend: suspension takes effect on the actor's next request, a legal serial order; the check only narrows what the function allowed before #4159, so it adds no race window. Covers this check only.
